 Galatasaray confirm high-grade hamstring injury for Rafael Leão 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Galatasaray said in a statement that Rafael Leão sustained a high-grade hamstring strain during the Süper Lig Week 11 fixture against Amed SK.
 The 27-year-old pulled up mid-match, signalled to the bench and was substituted early.
 OneFootball Videos
 He underwent immediate imaging at Maslak Acıbadem Hospital, the club’s sponsor hospital.
 Scans showed an advanced-stage strain with internal bleeding in the upper right hamstring muscle group.
 Rehabilitation has begun, with a structured recovery programme planned over the coming weeks. His status is listed as treatment and rehabilitation underway.
 Source: Turkish-Football.com
